Average meal for Vietnam
Nov 2015 • Family
As a restaurant stop over for people returning from Halong Bay overnight trips this was perhaps the poorest aspect of our otherwise great cruise tour. The food was adequate and you ate from a set shared banquet style menu, but the food was decidedly average after what we had consumed on our overnight cruise. If being generous it would have been difficult to compete with the food on the cruise, but even so the food was hardly inspiring. Service was average.
